checks.basis: validate_query accepts exactly {mode:active_observation}. Schema, argument validator and service reject pair/goal/scene_delta/instruction mixing. The service returns through the new branch before ordinary Q1-Q4 routing.

Requires Blender world metre capture, complete_scene_meshes identity, document epoch, revision, exact ordered host IDs, names and unique instance mapping. capture_state and complete fixed camera specification are retained. Geometry alone is not the cache key.

Cold service has one capture_scene call. observe_capture has one mapping, Fraction geometry, shared mesh conversion, camera fitting and parsed prepare call site. prepare_scene_from_parsed has zero geometry call sites.

Existing per-service ReadContext is used under its lock and observation scope. Each request freshly captures source. The source binding selects cached result, with include_image in the query key. Cache retains full SDK facts and frames before transport encoding.
Document/revision, capture token, ordered host IDs/instances/names are present in read selection binding. A rename changes that binding even when canonical geometry stays identical.

24 core definitions and 5 image helper definitions are exact AST matches to the accepted isolated product, excluding docstrings. Default discovery/optimized coverage/state and 16/4/24 helper semantics are unchanged.

Read against old freeze_cameras. Only load_meshes(scene) becomes shared meshes input, and registered constants move to product. Same complete-geometry center, basis, six directions/order, 1.10 symmetric span, _attention_camera, depth and inclusive frustum math.

Actual captured faces map to triangles directly. All parsed objects and their complete faces enter shared raster meshes. Canonical ROI corners are used for readability and never replace full occluder geometry.
include_image=false keeps zero observed/covered state and returns prediction_only. No image adapter loop executes.
No ROI returns unknown/no_supported_regions, zero frames and no raster. Capture object count, supported count and remaining host objects are explicit without fabricated per-object rejection reasons.

Engine local verified frames, native MCP blocks constructed and external consumer read are separate. Wire consumer_read_status stays unconfirmed. Local stdio readback proves transport only and explicitly records no model consumption.

Only active_observation uses six-frame/512px assembly. Ordinary image bundle path keeps its existing two-image/384 contract. Raw PNG SHA and sanitized bytes must match; base64 stays only in image blocks.

Transport omits camera_specification, frame pose and per-array metadata mirrors while retaining source identities, ref/path/hash/bytes, short facts and generation/current work/stages. Raw cached SDK result stays complete.

ReadContext stores the completed compute before MCP encoding. An encode failure raises with delivery audit, does not evict cached frames or call renderer again. A later same-source request captures freshness then hits that cache.

Service construction callback precedes render_view. Root-owned stdio wrapper reserves one of eight exclusive directories, fsyncs INTENT and JSONL before returning to the actual raster. Failed markers consume capacity and are not refunded.

QA module imports no bpy or scene side effects before run. Root-owned new background process, exclusive workspace, loopback ephemeral port and READY pid/source/deadline binding isolate temporary geometry. No existing background process is reused.

Capture wrapper archives and returns identical decoded capture once. Prepare wrapper archives the actual installed session index. Direct-core QA comparison uses that same capture plus generated cameras, maps actual host instances, and separately reports one extra QA parse/index with zero raster.
Scaled QA fixture and binary32 proof are predeclared. Product scene_from_capture preserves actual coordinates and faces and performs no rounding, welding, rescaling or tolerance fitting.

Popen and reader.start share constructor try protection. Constructor failures enter finish. Cleanup steps independently retain errors and still attempt bounded wait/kill/reap, stream and actual held-handle closure.
Final cleanup defers stdout.close when the reader remains alive, records false pipe closure and unconfirmed cleanup rather than blocking on the BufferedReader lock.

Protocol fixes ordinary, repeat, rename, nonplanar and minimal transport/regression requests. Expected four new rasters, hard cap eight. No added timing pairs or model inference. All real launches remain root-owned after freeze.

limits: Static approval does not establish real Blender capture, source refresh, native image receipt or measured cold/warm counts. Root owns the one frozen actual sequence.
Same-source direct-core comparison is a separate QA-only parse/index and cannot be counted as product cold work.
The private loopback QA and source guard are finite owned qualification mechanisms, not a general adversarial execution sandbox.
Background Blender Popen ownership and final close must be verified in actual root records. No shared GUI/default installation activation or model consumption is proven by this review.

resolved_pre_execution_findings.finding: A cleanup exception could skip subsequent held-process reclamation steps
resolved_pre_execution_findings.resolution: Independent bounded wait/kill/post-kill wait and separately guarded closure steps

resolved_pre_execution_findings.finding: Closing stdout while reader still holds BufferedReader lock could be unbounded
resolved_pre_execution_findings.resolution: Defer stdout close while reader alive, retain false/unknown cleanup evidence

reviewer_execution.analysis: Source text and AST only. No package source imported or executed.
